en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a wooded valley. Steep forested hills fill the background. In the middle distance a church with a tall spire rises above the trees, and scattered houses with steep gabled roofs occupy the lower slopes and valley floor. Dense vegetation and garden plots are visible in the foreground. The edges of the image are slightly darkened and worn, as with an old photographic postcard. No printed caption or writing is visible.
